main.subtitle: Weblings Inbox
main.title:
Enterprise Email Hosting.
Without the per-seat tax.
main.content: Stop paying extra every time you hire a new employee. Get unlimited custom domain email addresses, edge-network spam protection, and the ability to send massive 10GB attachments—all fully included in your Weblings Worksuite.

features.subtitle: Zero-Day Onboarding
features.title: From Offer Letter to Inbox in 3 Seconds.
content: Stop filing IT tickets just to get a new employee an email address. Because Inbox is deeply integrated with the E-Office HRMS, the workflow is entirely automated.
• HR Creates the Profile: Your HR manager adds the new hire in E-Office and selects their specific branch location from a simple dropdown.
• Instant Email Allocation: The system instantly creates their custom business email under the domain allocated to that specific location.
• Ready to Work: Within seconds, the new identity is populated across Team Chat, Streamline tickets, and the company directory.

features.subtitle: Military-Grade Perimeter
features.title: Secured by the Global Edge Network.
content: Email is the number one vector for corporate breaches. We route your entire inbox through the same infrastructure that protects the world's largest financial institutions.
• Advanced Anti-Phishing: Our perimeter network proactively detects attacker infrastructure, stopping targeted BEC and phishing attacks before they reach your inbox.
• Zero-Headache DNS: SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configure themselves automatically when you link or purchase a domain.
• Edge-Level Antivirus: Every attachment is scanned by multiple enterprise virus engines in isolated cloud sandboxes.
features.imageAlt: Secured by the Global Edge Network

features.subtitle: Intelligent Organization
features.title: Find Anything. Organize Everything.
content: • Semantic Vector Search: Stop guessing exact keywords. Our built-in AI uses vector embeddings to understand the meaning and context behind your search. Ask naturally and find the exact email immediately.
• Visual Color Tags: Visually segregate your inbox with custom, color-coded tags for projects, priority levels, or specific clients. Keep your workspace perfectly categorized.

features.subtitle: Unified Mobile Experience
features.title: Your Team, In Your Pocket.
content: You don't need a separate app for email, another for chat, and another for HR. The unified Weblings iOS and Android app puts your Enterprise Inbox right next to your Streamline tickets and Team Chat. Stay responsive to clients and collaborate seamlessly anywhere.

deliverabilityGuarantee.title: Emails that actually reach the primary inbox.
deliverabilityGuarantee.description: A single misconfigured MX record can send a $50,000 inbound lead straight to the spam folder. We engineered out the risk.

cards.title: Automated DNS Protocols
cards.description: Stop fighting with cryptic TXT records. When you link a domain, we automatically configure strict SPF, DKIM, and DMARC policies. Your domain reputation stays pristine, and Google/Microsoft instantly trust your outbound traffic.

cards.title: Edge Spam Defense
cards.description: Malicious payloads and phishing attempts are caught and dropped at the global edge network before they ever touch our servers or your employees' inboxes. Pure, clean traffic only.

cards.title: Zero-Downtime Migration
cards.description: Terrified of losing historical data? Our automated IMAP migration tool ports over years of emails, folders, and attachments from Google Workspace or Office 365 in the background, with absolutely zero downtime.

aiPrivacy.title: Ironclad AI Privacy & Zero-Knowledge Architecture
aiPrivacy.p1: We know you are sending investor updates, sensitive HR data, and financial reports through your inbox.
aiPrivacy.guarantee: We guarantee that our AI models are never trained on your private email data.
aiPrivacy.p2: The Weblings AI only parses email context when you explicitly hit the "Convert to Ticket" or "Summarize" buttons, and that temporary processing happens in isolated, ephemeral containers. Your data is yours. Period.

usage.subtitle: Enterprise Features
usage.title: Unrestricted Email, Fully Included.
usage.description: Stop rationing out email addresses to save money on user licenses. Create as many custom inboxes as you need for contractors, support aliases, or new hires.
usage.highlightText: It is 100% included in your flat Weblings Worksuite invoice.

cards.description: Route billing@ and support@ directly to your main inbox. Zero extra costs.

cards.title: 10GB Attachments
cards.description: Bypass the 20MB limit. Massive files automatically swap for secure Drive links.

cards.title: In-App DNS Setup
cards.description: Purchase and route domains directly within the app natively without touching Cloudflare.
